title: 🔎️ Repo search fixtures and wire shapes
description: 🔎️ The ranking vector file the `🔍️ranked-search` case reads, the persisted index event, and the projection every implementation must produce.

fuzziness.description: 🎚️ The largest edit distance a word may be away from the term.

documents.description: 📚️ Documents indexed first, in key order.

deleted.description: 🗑️ Identifiers deleted after the initial indexing.

reindexed.description: ♻️ Identifiers re-indexed with new text after the initial indexing.

terms.description: 🔎️ The conjunction; every term must match.

size.description: ✂️ Hits retained; a negative size retains everything.

IndexEvent.description: 📨️ One line of the persisted append-only index log.

seq.description: 🔢️ One-based, gapless; a gap is a corrupt index.

rankings.description: 🎯️ `<vector name>=<total>:<id>@<score>,<id>@<score>…` — the total counted before truncation, then the retained hits best first.
